findings.title: Missing Defensive HTTP Security Headers (3 missing)
findings.observation: The web server response does not include standard defensive headers: Content-Security-Policy (CSP), X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options.
findings.evidence: Response headers from https://sweetgreen.com/ were inspected. Found: {"hsts":"max-age=63072000","csp":null,"xFrameOptions":null,"xContentTypeOptions":null,"referrerPolicy":null,"permissionsPolicy":null}
findings.impact: Leaves the website vulnerable to clickjacking (missing X-Frame-Options), MIME-type sniffing, and cross-site scripting risks.
findings.recommendation: Configure your web server (Nginx/Apache/Cloudflare) to send HSTS, X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff headers.

findings.title: Images Missing Alt Text (4/36 images)
findings.observation: 4 images on the website lack descriptive alt attributes.
findings.evidence: Found across crawled pages. Sample missing alt images detected in DOM.
findings.impact: Prevents image search indexing in Google Images and makes visual content inaccessible to visually impaired users using screen readers.
findings.recommendation: Add concise, descriptive alt text to all meaningful images. Use empty alt="" for purely decorative background elements.

findings.title: Missing Canonical URL Tags (2/2 pages)
findings.observation: 2 pages do not declare a self-referencing canonical URL.
findings.evidence: Canonical tags are missing from <head> on 2 crawled pages.
findings.impact: Risk of duplicate content penalties when pages are accessed via different URL variations (HTTP vs HTTPS, trailing slash, query parameters).
findings.recommendation: Add self-referencing <link rel="canonical" href="https://..." /> tags in the <head> of every published page.

findings.title: Images Missing Accessible Alt Text (4 detected)
findings.observation: 4 image elements do not provide textual alternatives via alt attributes.
findings.impact: Assistive technology users (such as screen readers) cannot perceive the meaning or context of graphical content.
findings.recommendation: Add meaningful alt attributes describing the content or function of each image.

findings.title: Target Location (Los Angeles / National) Missing from Primary SEO Elements
findings.observation: The specified target geography "Los Angeles / National" was not prominently detected in page titles, meta descriptions, or main headings.
findings.evidence: Crawled 2 pages. Checked <title>, <meta description>, and <h1> tags against location "Los Angeles / National".
findings.impact: Reduces visibility in localized search queries, Google Maps / Local Pack results, and nearby customer discovery.
findings.recommendation: Incorporate "Los Angeles / National" naturally into the homepage title tag, H1 heading, service area sections, and footer contact block.

findings.title: Visual Hierarchy & Focal Point Modernization
findings.observation: Above-the-fold layout could benefit from stronger headline typography contrast, clear primary call-to-action prominence, and elevated modern spacing tokens.
findings.evidence: Evaluated 2 crawled templates. Visual inspection of hero and body sections indicates opportunity for enhanced visual contrast and modern design tokens.
findings.impact: Modern, high-contrast visual design builds instant visitor trust and dramatically improves engagement time on landing.
findings.recommendation: Implement a refined typographic hierarchy (48px+ H1 hero, 20px lead paragraph), distinct high-contrast CTA button styling, and consistent 64px+ section spacing.

findings.title: Lead Capture & Instant Engagement Opportunity
findings.observation: The website lacks instant real-time conversion channels such as floating WhatsApp buttons or frictionless 2-field lead capture forms.
findings.evidence: Inspected conversion triggers across 2 pages. Direct WhatsApp messaging links or streamlined quote forms were not detected in the primary navigation or sticky footer.
findings.impact: Up to 60% of modern mobile visitors prefer instant chat or 1-click quote requests over navigating to a separate contact page.
findings.recommendation: Add a persistent floating WhatsApp contact widget and an above-the-fold "Get Instant Quote" trigger.

executiveSummary.summary:
This comprehensive website audit evaluates the digital presence, customer journey, and conversion readiness of https://www.sweetgreen.com (Sweetgreen Restaurant & Bowls in Los Angeles / National). 
Based on 2 inspected pages and automated viewport testing, the website provides a foundational web presence with substantial commercial opportunities to accelerate customer trust, improve mobile engagement, and capture more inbound enquiries.

Key immediate priorities include introducing frictionless quote inquiry channels, refining page summaries for search engines, and modernizing layout contrast to highlight core services and proof of quality.

Clear multi-page structure covering 2 key customer areas.
topRisks: Missing immediate call or instant messaging buttons for high-intent visitors.
